Changes text case similar to Microsoft Word: Sentence case, lowercase, UPPERCASE, Capitalize Each Word, tOGGLE cASE

**Panel:** Comma → Data · **Nickname:** `Case`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Text | `T` | Text | Item |  | Text to change case |
| Case | `C` | Integer | Item | `0` | Specify case conversion type<br>Options: Sentence case; lowercase; UPPERCASE; Capitalize Each Word; tOGGLE cASE |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Text | `T` | Text | Item | Converted text |
